newsitem.title: USA: Titan names DeMarco as CFO.
newsitem.headline: Titan names DeMarco as CFO.

text.p: The Titan Corp said Eric DeMarco was named senior vice president and chief financial officer, effective January 15, 1997.
DeMarco succeeds Bernard Hirl, who has accepted a new position on the east coast.

DeMarco is a senior audit manager with Arthur Andersen LLP. He has served in the San Diego office of Arthur Andersen for the past 10 years and has been assigned to the Titan Corporation account since 1989. DeMarco graduated summa cum laude from the Whittemore School of Business at the University of New Hampshire in 1985.
